name: WheelPicker
summary: One to three scrolling columns, each resting on a value in a band across the middle: the wheel for a time of day or a short list of values. Each column is a spinbutton. On web it is the same wheel, scrolled by the mouse wheel, a mouse drag, a tap on a row or the keys. On ios the rows turn away on a curve around a soft band. On android each column is a plain scrolling list with the row in the band filled and no curve (Material has no wheel; its time pickers are a dial or a field, and the dial is a drag). Proposed.
useWhen: A time of day picked in a popover or a sheet on a phone: alarm, booking slot, reminder
A short list of values where the neighbours help: a duration in minutes, a count of nights, a day period
Two or three linked values chosen together: hours, minutes and AM or PM
avoidWhen: A value people type faster than they scroll: a year, a postcode, an exact amount
A long list of words, where reading and search matter more than flicking
A date with a month grid people scan by week

columns.description: One to three columns, each { id, label, options, value?, defaultValue?, loop? }. label is the accessible name of the column, never drawn (Hours). options are { value, label?, textValue?, disabled? }. value makes the column controlled. wheelTimeColumns in @the-system/shared builds a time wheel in the locale's order with Latin digits and Intl day period words.

label.description: The name of the group of columns, never drawn (convention 7): Alarm time, وقت المنبه.

onChange.description: Called with the column id and its new value when a column comes to rest on a new row, or a key or a tap chooses one.

loop.description: Every column wraps from its last row to its first (hours, minutes). A column's own loop wins, so a day period column can stay a short list.

disabled.description: No column changes. Columns stay focusable and say aria-disabled (convention 5). Stamps data-disabled on the root.

onTick.description: Called each time a new row crosses the band under a finger, a drag or a mouse wheel. The hook for haptic ticks: the feedback helper of order R3.9 is not built, so the wheel makes no haptic of its own yet.

a11y.role: group named by label, holding one spinbutton per column. Each spinbutton is named by its column label and reads its value by aria-valuetext (the row text). aria-valuenow is the value for a column of numbers, else the row number. The rows are drawn text, aria-hidden. The band is aria-hidden.
a11y.focus: One Tab stop per column. Left and Right move focus between columns by what is seen (mirrored in right to left). A 2px ring from color.focus.ring around the focused column.

keys.Tab: Moves to the next column, and out of the wheel after the last
keys.ArrowUp: The next value (a step down the list); wraps in a looping column
keys.ArrowDown: The previous value; wraps in a looping column
keys.ArrowRight: Focus to the column at the right
keys.ArrowLeft: Focus to the column at the left
keys.Digits and letters: Jump to the first value that starts with what was typed within a second: 4 then 1 is 41, 7 finds 07, p finds PM. Arabic Indic digits count as Latin digits.
keys.Pointer: A flick or a drag scrolls a column and it rests on the row in the band. The paths that need no drag (WCAG 2.2 2.5.7): a tap or click on any row in view chooses it, and every key above.

a11y.announce: Alarm time, group. Hours, spin button, 9. After a step the new value text is read. Disabled rows are skipped by keys and the wheel never rests on one.
notes: Rows are control md tall and never under the platform target: 32 on web, 44 on ios, 48 on android (WCAG 2.2 2.5.8). The band is one row tall.
Rows outside the band use color.text.muted at 4.5:1; they turn on the curve but are never faded below it (1.4.3). The row in the band uses color.text.default.
A disabled row is struck through as well as dimmed, so it is not told by colour alone (1.4.1).

Reduced motion (the system setting or data-motion reduce on the root element): keys and taps jump instead of gliding, a mouse drag rests where it is let go, and the curve is flat. A finger still scrolls and values still change (2.3.3).
Digits are Latin in every locale, ar-SA included. The day period words come from Intl for the locale with Arabic marks removed (ص and م).

Columns follow the reading direction: in Arabic the first column (hours) sits at the right and the day period at the left. The order of the time columns comes from Intl (wheelTimeOrder), so a locale that writes the day period first gets it first.
Under forced colors the band has a CanvasText edge, rows are CanvasText, disabled rows GrayText and the focus ring Highlight.

en.label: Names what the wheel sets: Alarm time, Reminder duration.
en.columns: Short nouns for each column label: Hours, Minutes, AM or PM. Rows are values, not sentences.

ar.label: اسم بصيغة اسمية بدون تشكيل: وقت المنبه، مدة التذكير.
ar.columns: أسماء قصيرة للأعمدة: الساعة، الدقائق، الفترة. الأرقام لاتينية دائما، وكلمتا الفترة من Intl: ص و م.

react.behavior: Scroll containers with CSS scroll snap, one spinbutton each; a mouse drag with dragVelocity and DETENT_PROJECTION from @the-system/motion; stepping, loops, typing and the time columns from wheel.ts in @the-system/shared
react.note: Motion: the scroll and the snap are the browser's; keys and taps glide with smooth scrolling; the curve is a transform from each row's distance to the band. Named under drag-drop, the catalog's drag and settle pattern; a wheel pattern of its own is a request to the motion owner. Reduced motion: keys and taps jump and the curve is flat.

angular.note: New wave 2: div[dsWheelPicker] with the same DOM and the same helpers from wheel.ts.

native.note: Phase R5 uses the system view: the wheel picker of @expo/ui on ios (a system picker, ruling 9) and, on android, the Material time input in a dialog, since the clock dial is a drag.

styles.web: The same wheel: columns with a soft band across the middle, rows turning away on a curve, scrolled by the mouse wheel, a drag, a tap or the keys.
styles.ios: Rows on a curve around a soft rounded band that spans every column; rows outside the band in the secondary label colour. Proposed platform rules are a request to the style owner.
styles.android: A plain scrolling list per column, no curve, the row in the band filled with the secondary container and square ends. Proposed platform rules are a request to the style owner.
styles.studio: The same on the Studio tokens; no recipe.
styles.desk: The same on the Desk tokens; no recipe.
styles.neutral: The same on the Neutral tokens; no recipe.
styles.liquid: The same on the Liquid tokens; no recipe. The band is the control layer, so a glass band is allowed (M9.21).

mistakes.wrong: A clock dial or a wheel as the only way to set a time
mistakes.right: WheelPicker, whose rows take a tap and whose columns take the keys, with no drag needed

mistakes.wrong: Fading the rows outside the band to a light grey
mistakes.right: color.text.muted at 4.5:1, with the curve doing the depth

mistakes.wrong: Arabic Indic digits or a day period written by hand
mistakes.right: wheelTimeColumns({ locale: 'ar-SA' }): Latin digits and the Intl words ص and م

mistakes.wrong: Listening for the row under the band on every scroll and saving it
mistakes.right: onChange, which fires once when the column rests
